# Opendate coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/check-opendate-coverage.mjs --write from docs/opendate-coverage.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

How each of Opendate's 455 API v2 endpoints maps onto Exos. The per-endpoint table, with the
Exos route or mechanism and the reason, is `docs/opendate-coverage.json`; CI checks it
(`node scripts/check-opendate-coverage.mjs`) so every endpoint is accounted for and every Exos route it names
exists and is documented in `docs/api`.

- **route**: an Exos partner-API route does the same.
- **equivalent**: Exos does it another way: another route shape, a signed-in RPC, an edge function or the dashboard.
- **not_applicable**: doesn't apply to Exos (platform-internal, another vendor's product, or a deliberate no).
- **planned**: not built yet.

## Totals

| | Endpoints | Share |
|---|---:|---:|
| route | 135 | 29.7% |
| equivalent | 198 | 43.5% |
| **covered (route + equivalent)** | **333** | **73.2%** |
| not_applicable | 58 | 12.7% |
| planned | 64 | 14.1% |
| **Opendate endpoints** | **455** | |

Exos routes beyond Opendate: **66** of the 259 rows in the route table
aren't named by any entry (Exos-only features, or finer-grained routes than Opendate's).

## Planned

| Category | Endpoint | Note |
|---|---|---|
| events | `GET /api/v2/confirms/{id}/similars` | No similar-events model yet |
| events | `GET /api/v2/confirms/{id}/cash_summary` | Box-office cash totals per event are in the dashboard report, not the API yet |
| events | `GET /api/v2/confirms/recommendations` | No recommendation model yet |
| tickets | `PUT /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/tickets/{barcode}` | Ticket edits (attendee name) are dashboard / holder actions; no API write yet |
| orders | `PUT /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/orders/{id}` | Order edits (buyer details) are dashboard actions; no API write yet |
| orders | `POST /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/orders/{id}/send_receipt` | Receipts are mailed at fulfilment; a resend is a dashboard action, not an API route yet |
| orders | `POST /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/orders/{id}/check_out` | Check out per ticket (POST /v1/tickets/:id/check-out); no whole-order check-out route yet |
| organizer_ticket_reservations | `POST /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/organizer_ticket_reservations/{token}/gift_card_redemptions` | Gift cards pay online orders (exos-checkout); not on API reservations yet |
| organizer_ticket_reservations | `DELETE /api/v2/confirms/{confirm_id}/organizer_ticket_reservations/{token}/gift_card_redemptions/{id}` | See gift_card_redemptions above |
